profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Rhombus Systems · Video streaming pipelines (GStreamer/RTSP/DASH), embedded Linux on ARM/Ambarella, computer vision at the edge · Patent holder
profile.summary:
Embedded software engineer specializing in camera systems, video streaming infrastructure, and embedded
 Linux. I work across the full stack of a camera fleet product — from board bring-up and firmware on
 ARM/Ambarella SoCs through GStreamer pipelines, fragmented MP4 storage, and cloud upload.

 At Rhombus Systems I did the platform bringup for the  R600, N100, and N500 camera platforms, along with AI-at-the-edge pipelines that run across the entire camera fleet. Day to day that means architecting RTSP-to-DASH
 streaming pipelines in C++, debugging at scale for example a CI build race that occasionally dropped the ethernet driver .ko from OTAs but was only needed on some hardware revisions. Sole inventor on US Patent 12,380,546 — computer-vision-based tamper detection for camera systems.

 Before Rhombus, I worked at Amazon Devices on consumer wearables (Echo Frames and Echo Buds) and spent
 a decade at WECO (Woodside Electronics) leading optical-sorter development for the food and ag industry
 — hardware, firmware, and systems integration end-to-end. Tools: C, C++, Python, GStreamer, embedded
 Linux (BusyBox/systemd), Ambarella, ARM, OpenCV, Git.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Platform bringup for the R600, N100, and N500 cameras and NVRs, covering video transcoding, codec pipelines, edge-inference paths, and optical characterization.

- Architected RTSP-to-DASH live streaming pipelines in C++ on GStreamer, handling fragmented MP4 muxing (splitmuxsink, fmp4mux), dynamic pad linking with dashsink, and DTS/PTS synchronization across decode and storage branches.

- Authored a FUSE-based virtual filesystem that maps journald logs to legacy file paths, removing a migration blocker without touching downstream consumers.

- Hunted memory and concurrency bugs with AddressSanitizer and ThreadSanitizer, including ODR violations and OpenCV parallelism data races.

- Sole inventor on US Patent 12,380,546, Systems and methods of computer vision-based tamper detection of camera systems, granted August 2025.
positions.insights: Camera Systems, Computer Vision and +8 skills

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Embedded software engineer at Amazon Devices on the Echo Frames smart-glasses team, contributing firmware and platform software for a resource-constrained wearable device.

- Major contributor to the over-the-air (OTA) firmware update flow for Echo Frames, working on the path that delivers updates to devices in the field.

- Implemented Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) changes spanning Echo Frames and Echo Buds, improving connectivity and supporting product features across both wearables.

- Drove bi-monthly SDK and third-party codebase merges across large embedded codebases, reconciling vendor updates with Amazon-side changes and keeping the team unblocked through complex integration cycles.

company.name: WECO, Woodside Electronics Corporation “The Science of Optical Sorting”

positions.title: Lead Project Engineer
positions.description:
- End-to-end development of optical sorters for the food and ag industry, from concept through electrical design, firmware, integration, and manufacturing release.

- Led small cross-disciplinary teams (engineers and technicians) on customer-specific sorter builds, balancing custom requirements against a common platform.

- Shipped a new generation of optical sorting product, integrating cameras, ejectors, PLCs, embedded firmware, and mechanical systems into a production-ready machine.

- Expanded the product line into industrial automation and moisture-monitoring applications.

- Hands-on across optical sensor selection, analog/digital PCB design (schematic + layout in Eagle), real-time sorting firmware, and machine control.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed analog and digital electronics for optical sorting machines: schematic capture, PCB layout, board bring-up, and debug in Eagle.

- Built embedded firmware and sensor interfaces for production sorters.

- Promoted to Lead Project Engineer to own full product development cycles.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: - Summer internship supporting electrical engineering and prototyping for optical sorters; converted to full-time at end of term.

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo

patents.title: Systems and methods of computer vision-based tamper detection of camera systems
patents.description: Computer-vision tamper detection for camera systems. Uses a paired infrared LED illumination cycle (on/off image comparison) to validate tamper events flagged by edge detection and other CV operations, filtering out false positives caused by rapid lighting changes.
